subject: Like Like
text: Link can defeat the Like Like in the Reservoir at close quarters.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Like Like by going kamikaze on it (at these close quarters you don't
have much choice)

subject: Gold Skulltula Token
text: Link can kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall in the Reservoir to take its token.

evidence.quote: kill the Gold Skulltula on the wall.  Take it's token.

subject: Pit Room
text: Falling through one of the pits in the Pit Room leads down into the Cess Pool.

evidence.quote: Allow yourself to fall through one of the pits in the room.

subject: Bomb Flowers
text: Bomb Flowers can be used to blow up the rocks blocking the path south in the Cess Pool.

evidence.quote:
Run south from where you land, and use the Bomb Flowers to blow the rocks
blocking your path to pieces.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: After bombing the rocks blocking the torch-flanked hall and killing the Redead, Link can open the chest to get the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
Blow the rocks out of your way with a Bomb, then run to the
end of the hall.  Kill the Redead, then open the chest to get the Dungeon Map.

subject: Treasure Chest Game
text: The Treasure Chest Game is entered through the door in the southeast corner of the Market at night, located to the left of the Bombchu Bowling Alley.

evidence.quote:
Play the Sun's Song to make it nighttime if you have to, then head for the door
in the southeast corner of the area.  It's to the left of the Bombchu Bowling
Alley, near the entrance to the back alley.  Go through it.

subject: Treasure Chest Game
text: Using the Lens of Truth allows Link to see inside each chest and take the Small Key in each room without guessing.

evidence.quote:
Simply use the Lens of Truth to see the contents of
each chest, and take the Small Key in each room.

subject: Piece of Heart
text: The lone chest in the final room of the Treasure Chest Game contains a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
When you reach the last room
in the minigame, you will find a lone chest which contains a Piece of Heart.

subject: Master Sword
text: Taking the Master Sword in the Temple of Time returns Link to adulthood.

evidence.quote:
Return to the
Temple of Time and take the Master Sword to return to Adulthood.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: Adult Link can play the Nocturne of Shadow to warp to the outside of the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Back on Adult Link, play the Nocturne of Shadow to return to the outside of the
Shadow Temple.

subject: Shadow Temple Entrance
text: Using Din's Fire while standing on the pedestal in the middle of the torches lights them all and opens the door to the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the pedestal in the middle of the torches and use Din's Fire
to light all of the torches... All of the lit torches will open the door to the Shadow Temple.  Go
through it.

subject: Entrance Pit
text: Link must use the Longshot on the far target to pull himself across the long pit near the entrance.

evidence.quote:
There is a long pit here, with a Longshot target on the other end.
Pull yourself across with the Longshot.

subject: Carved Face Wall
text: Running straight through the face carved in the wall leads into the Raven Room.

evidence.quote:
Run straight through the face carved
in the opposite wall into the next room.

subject: Raven Statue
text: Using the Lens of Truth reveals the skull that does not disappear, and pushing the Raven statue to face it opens the grating across the room.

evidence.quote:
Use the Lens of Truth on the posts, and find the post
which has the skull that does not disappear when exposed to the Lens.  Use the
handle on the front of the Raven statue to push it so that the Raven faces the
"real" Skull... Once
the Raven is facing the proper skull, the grating on the other side of the room
will open.

subject: Fake Face Wall
text: Using the Lens of Truth on the wall opposite the large pit reveals a fake face on the right leading down a hall and through a door.

evidence.quote:
Turn around and face the wall opposite the large pit, where you will see more
of those faces carved into the wall.  Use the Lens of Truth to find the fake
face on the right side of the wall.  Run through it, down the hall and through
the door at the other end.

subject: Catacombs Fake Walls
text: All fake walls in this section of the Catacombs have skulls with glowing blue eyes, whereas skulls with flashing blue eyes hold secret messages.

evidence.quote:
The wall in front of you has a skull with blue, glowing eyes.  Keep this detail
in mind; all of the fake walls in this next area will have glowing blue eyes.
The skulls with flashing blue eyes have secret messages.

subject: Catacombs
text: Heading through the glowing eye wall, going right around the corner, and using the Lens of Truth reveals a fake wall on the right leading to the Redead Room.

evidence.quote:
Run forward through the wall, and go right on the other side.  Run around the
corner, and use the Lens to see through a fake wall on the right.  Go through
the wall and through the door on the other side.

subject: Dungeon Map
text: Defeating the Redead and the two Keese high above in the room causes the Dungeon Map to appear.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Redead in the room, and then look high above to find two Keese.  Kill
them as well, and a Dungeon Map will appear.  Take the Map, then turn around
and go back into the Catacombs.
